name: Update a member's contact information
description: Change the e-mail, phone and mailing address held for a member, then read the values back off the member record and return them. The host's acknowledgement banner only says a write was accepted; returning the stored state proves it landed, which is the same reason a fill is verified by reading the control rather than by trusting the keystroke.
goal: Sign on, open member {member_id}, update their contact details to email {email}, phone {phone}, address {address}, then confirm the stored record shows the new values.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.

outputs.name: email
outputs.description: E-mail as it now stands on the member record, read back after saving.

outputs.name: phone
outputs.description: Phone as it now stands on the member record, read back after saving.

success.description: back on the member record with the saved values
